title.narrative: Safe & quality education for girls and boys in displacement situations in Ethiopia & Somalia (BRICE)

description.narrative: The project falls under the “Building Resilience in Crisis through Education (BRICE)” EU call for proposal and is a four-year multi country consortium led project which aims at contributing to building community and institutional resilience in Gambella and Puntland by increasing access to quality and inclusive pre-school and primary education for boys and girls in displacement situations. Its specific objective is to develop evidence-based models to deliver safe quality basic education for children in fragile and protracted crisis environments, contributing to building at the same time societal and institutional resilience to make these actions sustainable over time._x000d_
